title: 恶魔会社：入职
description:
​​Corporate Judge: Ctrl+Alt-Get Even!​​

This RPG Maker-crafted strategy game weaponizes your workplace trauma into cathartic combat. Experience the ultimate "anti-hustle" fantasy of toppling toxic CEOs and yeeting unreasonable deadlines into the void.

​Warning to Under-35 Wage Slaves:​​ May cause accidental deployment of sass during performance reviews. Handle with care.

GamePlay: Tower of Druaga + PersonaGameplay blends Tower of Druaga's tactical battles with Persona's social mechanics, remixed with puzzle-solving (imagine rearranging Jira tickets), match-3 stress relief (combo those TPS reports!), and roguelike office politics. 

 

Story: Rookie Programmer meets Mysterious Cat Set in Cyber-Tokyo's corporate dystopia, you play as ​​Togawa Tsubasa​​ - a rookie programmer who accidentally sold her soul to Blackstone Corp. By day, she's a code monkey surviving micromanagement hell. By night, her consciousness rebels in the ​​Midnight World​​ after meeting Vita, a glitch-spewing cat who turns corporate jargon into combat spells.

Recruit fellow broken souls from accounting purgatory and HR hellscape. Weaponize their burnout as special abilities. Storm the C-suite labyrinth where your manager's "culture-building exercises" have literally summoned a KPI Demon.
description_short: This game is a strategy RPG with the theme of anti-work from 9 am to 9 pm, six days a week. The gameplay inherits from the classic "Magic Tower" series, combining elements such as pigeons and BD combinations. Please play with caution under the age of 35 to avoid dissing and hurting the boss!
